cohort_test_shots_used_scope: reviewed-label detector CV only; original-refit overlap is reported separately

model_context.refit_checkpoint_note: one-epoch checkpoint selected from a seven-epoch run
model_context.photodiode_columns: pcphd02 and pcphd03 mean-filled on every shot
model_context.serving_changes: 50 ms-mean serving on a 25 ms grid of a 1 ms-trained model; no D-alpha input (pcphd02/03 mean-filled); CO2 missing on 75/119; |z| clipped at 10
model_context.training_resolution_note: 1 ms refers to the source survival fit; detection heads are refitted on reviewed 50 ms-mean rows.

serving.interpretation: offline risk score, not a causal forecast
serving.training_note: survival refit trained on source 1 ms rows; detection variants refitted on reviewed 50 ms-mean rows

preprocessing_exposure.scope: upstream feature means/std computed before source split

source.operation: model10_norms mean/std computed over final_x before phase train/test split

preprocessing_exposure.role: feature-statistics exposure, independent of reviewed-label CV
preprocessing_exposure.decision: retain as supplemental; confirmatory detection refits preprocessing

model_context.temporal_interpretation: Offline risk score with 25 ms centered-NBI lookahead (not a causal forecast)
model_context.normalization_exposure: The confirmatory elm-dsm detection fits normalization only on optimizer-training shots in each fold and starts from independent random weights. Refit and historical detection exposed/init reuse upstream pre-split statistics including blind-cohort shots 190646 and 190532; historical init additionally reuses refit weights.
model_context.scope: This record scores the limited-input adaptation; the original 124-input native 1 ms checkpoint is evaluated separately in native_evaluation.json (four exact-export scored shots and a 33-shot reconstructed sensitivity panel).
model_context.input_audit_scope: Historical survival/refit and exposed/init input paths are described by photodiode_columns, serving_changes and row_diagnostics. The current source-isolated detector uses detection_input_repair, with measured PCPHD02/03 and quality-screened DENV2F/3F; its normalization is fold-local.

own_target.phase_id_encoding: upstream <physical shot>_<phase>; old int(string) rendering is physical shot * 10 + phase for single-digit phases
own_target.selection_note: The original test rows were passed as val_data for early stopping; own-target metrics are validation evidence, not untouched held-out evidence.
own_target.overlap_scope: original refit training and early-stopping validation, separately from reviewed-label detector CV, which excludes cohort test shots

detection_input_repair.scope: isolated detector only; survival and historical scores unchanged
detection_input_repair.photodiodes: PCPHD02/03 preferred; FS02/03 50 ms means are explicit substitutes only when a photodiode record is unavailable
detection_input_repair.co2_v2_v3: DENV2F/3F native-ordinate 50 ms means; the same fixed failed-digitiser screen as elm-ours rejects median magnitude >1e16 and fills that column at the fold mean. Live metadata says V; physical conversion unresolved, no rescaling
detection_input_repair.co2_r0_v1: original slow CO2 when available, else fold mean
detection_input_repair.normalization: optimizer-training shots only, independently per fold
detection_input_repair.initialization: independent seeded random weights, unchanged recipe
